title: AWS Certificate Manager: free TLS certificates

kcs.statement: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) provisions, manages and automatically renews public SSL/TLS certificates at no extra cost, for use with integrated services such as Elastic Load Balancing, CloudFront and API Gateway. This is how those services serve HTTPS (encryption in transit).

problem_ideas: A site behind an Application Load Balancer must move from HTTP to HTTPS without manual renewals. Name the service.
A certificate expired last year and caused an outage. Which ACM feature prevents a repeat?
Pick the service for each need: manage encryption keys, issue TLS certificates, store database passwords.
Can a public ACM certificate be installed directly on an EC2 instance's web server? Explain why exam questions pair ACM with ELB and CloudFront instead.
How much does a public certificate from ACM cost?
Which type of encryption does ACM help with: at rest or in transit?
